name: 东方故事(蓝天)
english_description: The original "ES1" engine (in-game name "东方故事1MUD", i.e. "Eastern Story 1 MUD", admin account admin/mudren per its own README) -- the ancestor of this project's already-onboarded es2/haiyang2/demonangel/xkx2001/rzrmud/xo family, but a genuinely earlier and architecturally distinct generation, not a duplicate of any of them. Content-compared against es2: same TMI/MudOS lineage headers and adm/ + cmds/ + feature/ + std/ + d/ layout convention, but es1's own world (d/abyss, d/adventurer, d/deathland, d/eastland, d/god, d/island, d/killer, d/knight, d/mage, d/magic, d/martial, d/monk, d/moorth, d/noden, d/scholar, d/swordman, d/thief, d/translate) shares zero domain names with es2's (canyon/choyin/city/force/temple/village/etc). Despite the wuxia-sounding mud name, this is actually a Western-style D&D-flavored fantasy world: registration is English-name-only (no Chinese-name/is_chinese() machinery exists anywhere in this snapshot -- that entire bug class postdates this build), and new characters choose from 16 playable races (human, elf, dwarf, orc, gnome, halfling, lizardman, imp, daemon, centaur, drow, beholder, vampire, hawkman, shapeshifter) plus a gender, landing at the Adventurer's Guild (冒险者公会) in Farwind Town. A near-identical (~90% file-content match once GBK-vs-CRLF differences are normalized) copy of this exact "东方故事(蓝天)/Blue Sky" build is already in this collection as es1_win (008, from a separately-sourced .rar snapshot) -- the two are clearly the same underlying codebase at different points in its edit history (roughly 10% of files differ beyond whitespace), onboarded here as an independent git-history-verifiable snapshot per this project's established precedent for near-duplicate archives (e.g. jyqxc/jyqxc2).
